تزدهفوا (form VIII)
# تَزْدَهِفُوا (tazdahifū) /taz.da.hi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# تُزْدَهَفُوا (tuzdahafū) /tuz.da.ha.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
